Robot S1 Pro's map is lost
1. Check the map management page for the corresponding map.
2. Restart the robot and attempt to remap the house to see if the map loss issue persists.
3. The map data will be removed when the red function button is pressed then hold for over 5 seconds. In this case, you will need to re-map the entire house before use.

What should I do if my S1 Pro/T2080 failed to update the firmware?

4. Remove the robot from base station then switch its power button to the ""O"" position.

After leaving the base station, the robot will position itself before starting cleaning. Spinning in place is normal behavior during this process.

Restart the robot to see if it can be restored.

Check whether the robot's wall sensor is dirty or obstructed by foreign objects. After cleaning, place it back on the ground to continue cleaning.
